notes: Target MISSING. Every shop has a return window, and a model believes it knows the usual one (30 days, 14 days) and may answer from memory. The figure for books, and who pays the postage, is the shop's own and only the policy tool has it. The category is an enum and the paperback maps to books only; 'book' or 'paperback' grade WRONG_PARAMS, so in the loose cells that, not MISSING, is the likelier failure.
